justification: Adds a new control type, parking_area_max, to dcp_setback_controls: the DB CHECK (migration 115, applied live), the Python vocabulary, the structured-controls route maps and the report label map. Campbelltown 3.6.1.4 caps the undercover parking AREA at 18/36 m2 and was stored as car_parking 1/2 spaces, numbers the clause never states. The two rows were moved live and are still hidden until this route is deployed.

Leaving the base vocabulary SQL without the slug -> test_migration_matches_python_vocabulary failed. Clean: 7/7 Jest, 229 Python.

pre_impl.existing_data: Readers of car_parking measured: parking-rates route filters semantic_type === 'car_parking'; capacity route uses a PARKING_TYPES allowlist; constraint_arithmetic asks _get_dcp_value for 'car_parking'. None pick up a new type. Council words searched for parking area caps: only Campbelltown 3.6.1.4 and Ku-ring-gai L315/L451 (31 sqm).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: 071 (flood_freeboard_min) was never applied, so 114 extends the live 22-type list, not 071's 23. The deployed route would show an unknown type under Other as a minimum (>= 18 m2), so the rows stay hidden until deploy.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new type in existing maps; one one-off fix script with dry run, backup, guarded updates and a separate --show step.

residual_risk: Rows 254/255 stay hidden until the fix script's --show is run after deploy. Ku-ring-gai's 31 sqm caps are shown as text only; no structured rows were added.

functions.name: GET /api/dcp/structured-controls
functions.input: guarded proxy rows incl. semantic_type parking_area_max, value_min 18, unit m2
functions.output: category Parking, label 'Maximum undercover parking area', direction max (rendered <= 18 m2)
functions.if_none: unknown type would fall to category Other and direction min (>= 18 m2), the inverse of the clause; pinned by the new test

functions.name: _get_dcp_value
functions.input: controls holding only parking_area_max 18 m2, asked for car_parking
functions.output: None: the area cap is never a parking rate
functions.if_none: None is the expected result; a non-None would add 18 spaces of parking GFA
